programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: The teams move onto the guest bedrooms, needing to transform two full spaces that must feel unique yet cohesive with the rest of their Lake House; these rooms must suit any type of guest, and maybe even outshine the primary! But as a blast from the past shakes up the challenge, the teams must get creative to adapt and impress; riding the highs of recent wins and reeling from tough losses, teams take bigger risks, and dig deep as time, energy and patience run thin in the final weeks.

programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: Ranjit bought her little home when she was a bachelorette; fast-forward 20 years later, and the walls are closing in on her family of three. Ranjit and husband Nabeel are in desperate need of a reset, but they don't know how to start. Kortney and Kenny guide them through a massive declutter, turning a man cave into a teenage-friendly space, making room for living, and calming the chaos.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: A family moves to Laurel, Miss., to escape cold Canadian winters, and are looking for big rooms and plenty of outdoor space for four boys; Ben and Erin present a rural bungalow on a huge piece of land and a home with a backyard bonus feature.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: Jones College has a special place in Ben and Erin's hearts; they are asked to restore The Old President's House; it's a team effort as students, past and present, step in to help make this house feel less institutional and more like a home.
